_about: Phase 3 FIXTURES, not model output. Written by hand in the planner's format (Proposal, packages/core/src/reality/proposal.ts) and the fresh look's format (RevisitSuggestion, packages/core/src/reality/revisit.ts), and checked by validateProposal and validateRevisit through the real RealityStore in packages/web/src/reality/phase3.fixtures.test.ts. They are served by intercepting POST /api/plan and POST /api/revisit in e2e/phase3.spec.ts and docs/validation/full-experience/capture-phase3.mjs; nothing is sent to a provider. No fixture contains a number: every figure in the journeys is typed by the test, as a user would. gaming-first answers the question without context (it asks two optional questions); gaming-tailored answers it with the user's answers; cello is an unusual question with no kind of place (the open sky). gaming-revisit is a fresh look at one path: `reconsider` names suggestions by their text (`match`), and the test fills in their ids from the request it receives.
